sections.brief: Structure (17,541 US agencies 2018 vs one national force under Ben-Gvir since Nov 2022); US police killings 2013-2025 (MPV 1,383 in 2024, 1,314 in 2025; Black 0.75 vs white 0.29 per 100k; charges ~2%->~4%); Israel: no public series; October 2000 (Orr Commission 2003, Mahash no indictments 2005); Eyad al-Hallaq (2020, acquittal 2023); Yesh Din 93.6% settler files closed; police exchanges and the unsupported causal claim (link ow6_exchanges). WPB incarceration rates US 1980-2023 (220->755 peak 2008->542) and Israel 1972-2023 (138->302 in 2006 after army prisons passed to IPS->153 in 2021->217 in 2023, 136% occupancy); the simulation's 108-122 estimate not carried; plea bargains (US federal FY2022 89.5%; Israel >85%, 2012 study; Guetzkow); death penalty (US executions 1999-2026, 27 states, death row 2,024; Israel Eichmann 1962 and the 30 March 2026 law, petitions, 17 May order, status as of Oct 2026); conditions (PHRI 94 deaths in custody Oct 2023-Aug 2025; Supreme Court food order).
